module: Tools to save and restore a rally vehicle's fuel (for example after a reset or a repair). createFuelSnapshot analyzes the energyStorage data: with a single valid gasoline/diesel tank, it stores the current level ('remembered' mode); otherwise it plans a full tank ('full' mode) with the reason for the fallback. applyFuelSnapshot reapplies the snapshot via core_vehicleBridge.
notes: Only 'gasoline' and 'diesel' fuels are remembered; an electric battery, multiple tanks, or another storage type (other than n2oTank) force the 'full' mode.
The energies are those of energyStorage (game unit, inferred from code).
Snapshot: {mode='full'|'remembered', tanks={...}, reason=string|nil}. In 'full' mode, tanks contains {name, maxEnergy}; in 'remembered', {name, currentEnergy}.

createFuelSnapshot.desc: Builds a fuel snapshot from a vehicle's energyStorage data.

energyStorageData.desc: List of energy storages (storageType, energyType, name, currentEnergy, maxEnergy).

returns.desc: {mode, tanks, reason}; reason explains why it falls back to a full tank.

requestFuelSnapshot.desc: Asynchronously requests the 'energyStorage' value from the vehicle (core_vehicleBridge.requestValue) then calls callback with the snapshot. Without a vehicle, calls callback immediately with an empty 'full' snapshot.

applyFuelSnapshot.desc: Applies the snapshot: in 'remembered' mode puts currentEnergy back in each tank; otherwise fills each tank to maxEnergy (with a warning in the log if a reason is provided). Uses the vehicle action setEnergyStorageEnergy. Does nothing without a vehicle, without a snapshot or without a tank.

reason.desc: Context for the log message ('recovery' by default).
